column1: # Keep the standard NVS/OTA/application offsets used by the existing firmware
# and reserve the final 4 KiB sector for one-time WebFlash provisioning data.
# The firmware imports that record into Preferences/NVS on first boot and
# immediately erases this partition so Wi-Fi credentials do not remain twice.
